function.name: dropbox
function.description: Manages the local NOVA Drop Box where the user links files. It can either list the files currently registered in the Drop Box, or read the text content of a specific file inside it.

action.description: What to do with the Drop Box. Either 'list_files' or 'read_file'.

filename.description: If action is 'read_file', provide the exact name of the file to read.

start_line.description: Optional line number to start reading from. Useful if the user asks you to resume reading or skip ahead.
